meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 给已有的谈话、采访或播客视频,配上与说话内容同步的图形卡片——如标题、下三分之一文字、数据标注、引语、侧栏、画中画。原视频保持不动,Claude会按转录内容设计卡片,并生成一个带包装的新视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户提到“graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”等关键词,或要求给视频做包装/装饰(package/dress up)时触发;若只是想加普通字幕,则不会触发。

say.text: 把这个采访视频加上动态标题和数据标注卡片
say.note: Claude会分析转录,设计并添加图形卡片。

say.text: 给我的播客视频配上下三分之一信息条和引语
say.note: 原视频保持,叠加图形后导出新视频。

say.text: 把这段演讲视频包装成竖屏9:16,画中画加侧栏数据
say.note: 指定画布比例,Claude按转录设计卡片。

howto.what_en: Adds timed graphic overlay cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP) to an existing talking-head video, synced to the transcript. Original clip stays untouched; Claude designs cards in chat and renders to MP4 via hyperframes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'graphic overlays', 'on-screen graphics', or asks to package/dress up a video. Not for plain subtitles; if unclear, routed to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add dynamic titles and data callout cards to this interview video.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the transcript and adds designed cards.

say_en.text: Add lower-thirds and quotes to my podcast video.
say_en.note: Original clip stays, overlays added, new video exported.

say_en.text: Package this talk as 9:16 portrait with PiP and side-panel data.
say_en.note: Canvas ratio specified; Claude designs cards from transcript.
